scope: Three static original candidates for the separate Sentinel Circuit missions; no pack/runtime/binding adoption.

images.title: Listening Court
images.visualReview: Cool cyan mist and moss-green communications court, broad courtyard and passages, warm brick detail, small open-frame FPV with battery/camera and restrained blue/yellow. Original visually inspected. Rotor motion is stylized; exact blade mechanics are not certified.

images.title: Switchyard Gates
images.visualReview: Warm amber rail yard with two gantries, converging tracks, distant warehouse and disabled unmarked equipment. Small FPV foreground contrasts against broad scenery. Battery has tiny decorative marks; no readable brand/instruction relied on. Rotor motion is stylized.

images.title: Open The Circuit
images.visualReview: Violet mountain signal station with a large inert radar dish, amber service opening, layered terrain and a small FPV with fine trailing cable. Original visually inspected. Cable and equipment illustrate the fictional setting rather than technical behavior.
